v4.9.075 - the deletion that could never land (#350)

Roman's log named it: every push said

    project settings changed - sending: setupPalette/setupPalette (deleted)

A deleted settings item was sent carrying its OLD change time. The server only
takes an item newer than the one it holds, and the old time is not newer than
itself - so the deletion was refused, silently, every single time. The device
then had a row it could never be rid of: it pushed on every pass, which moved
the project's clock, which made the heartbeat pull, which pushed again.

That is the churn. One row, retired by #331, unable to die.

A deletion now travels with the time it was DELETED. Bench case added so it
cannot come back.
